visual_action: A clip of Donald Trump speaking while seated at a table during a C-SPAN broadcasted event. He is wearing a dark suit and a blue tie. The background is a blue curtain with repeating text that says 'MAKE AMERICA SAFE AGAIN' and 'MEMPHIS, TENNESSEE'. A chyron is visible at the bottom of the screen.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the only person shown and is speaking throughout the entire video.

on_screen_text.text: Trump: We have young women in the White House. ... I would say beautiful young women
TRUMP HOSTS ROUNDTABLE ON CRIME & PUBLIC SAFETY

WE HAVE THE WHITE YOUNG WOMEN. I WOULD SAY YOUNG WOMEN EVER SINCE I GOT ELECTED, I DON'T LIKE TO SAY THAT BECAUSE USUALLY WHEN YOU SAY A BEAUTIFUL WOMAN, ISN'T SHE BEAUTIFUL? THAT'S THE END OF YOUR POLITICAL CAREER. SO I NEVER SAY THAT.

spoken_summary: Donald Trump discusses having 'young women' working in the White House, who he says he would 'normally' call 'beautiful young women.' He adds that since becoming president, he avoids saying things like that because commenting on a woman's beauty could be 'the end of your political career,' concluding, 'so I never say that.'
audio_music: The audio consists solely of Donald Trump's speech from the event, with no added music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video uses a single, static, talking-head shot of Donald Trump. The editing consists of adding an overlay text box at the top and synchronized, word-by-word captions at the bottom.
central_claim: Donald Trump makes objectifying and bizarre comments about the 'beautiful young women' working for him, suggesting he is creepy and sexist.
intended_effect: To generate disapproval and disgust for Donald Trump by highlighting his comments about women.
